name: LiteLLM + Ollama Gateway
description: Installs a LiteLLM proxy and Ollama daemon as in-container services. Exposes a unified OpenAI-compatible API at http://localhost:4000.

ollamaModel.description: Ollama model to pull on container start (leave empty to skip auto-pull).

litellmVersion.description: pip version specifier for litellm, e.g. '1.40.0' or 'latest'.

enableBedrock.description: Add AWS Bedrock models to the LiteLLM config (requires AWS env vars at runtime).

enableAnthropic.description: Add Anthropic models to the LiteLLM config (requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY at runtime).

enableOpenAI.description: Add OpenAI models to the LiteLLM config (requires OPENAI_API_KEY at runtime).
